analysis.reasonEn: Shifted to buy on 2026-09-08 after 3 prior sessions of wait-and-see, maintaining an uptrend for 2 consecutive days. RSI rose from oversold territory (41.3) to 48.6, and MACD histogram improved from 0.0854 to 1.4850, signaling bullish expansion. Higher Low pattern confirmed with the 5-day low ($98.62) not lower than the 20-day low ($98.62). Current price ($123.27) is above SMA20 ($122.99), supporting the uptrend.
